A rabbit mouse experiencing an identity crisis.
Though a rabbit, she was raised by her mouse father, leading to confusion between rabbit and mouse identities. She tries to fit into the villainous image of Black Spica but lacks the talent for it. Instead, she tends to see good deeds as the virtues of a villain.
